title: 点火唯一完整总架构图
subtitle: 唯一完整总架构图；0.16.0 Current 派生投影，0.14.0 为 Historical。主干是 Owner/Value Charter → Ignition OS driver / R8 Task Lifecycle Decoupling & Executor Admission → Pack/Federation routing → provider-neutral Executor Admission → Live External Executor Bridge → 外部可替换执行器（external replaceable executors；external executors）→ Actions/Receipts → Validation/Feedback → OS；Formal Task Lifecycle 与 Open Obligation Registry 分别记录任务终态和长期义务，前者可以引用后者但不由 obligation liveness 推导；Executor Admission 只按统一安全、auth、structured-result、capture、workspace、cleanup 与 validator 维度决定是否进入 bounded live bridge，不拥有 provider、channel、browser、remote Git、配置、billing 或 completion authority；Current 将 dispatch crossing、process observation、independent inference marker、structured result return 与 validated completion 分开，FailureForensicsCapsule 在 raw spool disposal 前保留脱敏诊断；Steering / Intent / Goal / Obligation 是 OS 内的有界权威来源、生命周期、依赖、优先级、arbitration 与 why-next 记录，不推断真实 Owner 意图或完成；Durability / Lifecycle R3 是 OS 内的有界持久化、恢复、迁移、命名空间、Pack 生命周期、撤销、账本与 DR 连续性记录，不是第二张图，也不自动重放不确定外部副作用；Structural Governance Surface 是 advisory cross-cutting overlay，不增加 L7，不改变 capability、permission 或 epistemic status；Event Ledger、monotonic policy、resource arbitration、bounded scheduler、health lease、queue/backpressure、dispatch/reconciliation、concurrent operational memory、Durability / Lifecycle、Steering、Task Lifecycle、Obligation Registry、Executor Admission 与 Driver Console 都是有界控制记录；Reference / Conformance / Fallback 是本地冻结边界；Kernel ≠ Knowledge，Runtime ≠ Research，Pack 不拥有通用 authority；语言—思维横穿 L0—L6，不增加 L7。连线是仓库关系、同步义务或候选反馈，不自动表示现实因果。

nodes.label: Owner / Human
nodes.description: Owner / Human 入口：保留价值、权限和停止边界，不被 Agent 自行改写。

nodes.label: 智能体化边界 R0
nodes.description: Agentization Boundary R0 的领域切割、依赖方向与不迁移处置。

nodes.label: Ignition Generic Kernel R0
nodes.description: 领域无关的身份、权限、状态、审计、checkpoint、handoff 和不变量契约。

nodes.label: Agent Runtime R2 (R0 base)
nodes.description: R0 typed loop 加上 R1 真实本地行动与 R2 的 Pack、Memory、Supervisor、Profile、Gateway、Routing 边界；仍保持领域无关。

nodes.label: Agent Profile R0
nodes.description: 可持久 Agent 身份、Owner/Charter 引用、能力类和禁止自我升级策略。

nodes.label: Feedback / Memory / Correction Loop
nodes.description: Working State 与可追溯 Durable Memory Event 的最小记录回路，不引入向量数据库。

nodes.label: Event Ledger R1
nodes.description: Append-only typed event ledger with aggregate CAS, hash-chain integrity, deterministic replay and snapshot-tail recovery.

nodes.label: Monotonic Policy Compiler R1
nodes.description: Digest-bound effective-policy compiler whose intersections, minima, expiry and prohibitions can only narrow authority.

nodes.label: Resource Arbitration R1
nodes.description: Hierarchical typed resource-intent arbitration with atomic acquire-many, expiring leases and conservative unknown-side-effect serialization.

nodes.label: Bounded Concurrent Scheduler R1
nodes.description: Bounded concurrent dependency-DAG scheduler with deterministic readiness, resource leases, budgets, cancellation, deadlines and checkpoint/resume.

nodes.label: Executor Health Lease R1
nodes.description: Digest-bound executor capability and health lease with expiry, cooldown, stale rejection and deterministic route candidates.

nodes.label: Queue and Backpressure R1
nodes.description: Durable bounded queue with quota/backpressure, priority and aging, deadline, pause and cancellation boundaries.

nodes.label: Durable Dispatch and Reconciliation R1
nodes.description: Durable external dispatch, idempotent acknowledgement/progress and conservative receipt reconciliation with forged-record rejection.

nodes.label: Concurrent Operational Memory R2
nodes.description: Concurrent operational memory with generation CAS, duplicate suppression, supersession/tombstones, stale capsules and deterministic compaction.

nodes.label: Durability / Lifecycle R3
nodes.description: Repository-local durability and lifecycle spine for snapshot plus tail, compaction, schema migration, namespace isolation, Pack lifecycle, revocation, accounting, recovery orchestration and disaster-recovery bundles; uncertain external effects stop at reconciliation and are never rerun automatically.

nodes.label: Steering / Intent / Goal / Obligation R1
nodes.description: Repository-local steering spine for provenance-aware intents, goal lifecycle, independent completion contracts, commitments, temporal windows, dependency-aware priority, conflict arbitration, explainable why-next traces, drift guards, memory/profile boundaries, namespace isolation and federation capsules; it cannot infer Owner intent or completion.

nodes.label: Formal Task Lifecycle R1
nodes.description: Independent formal-task terminality authority: scope, steps, publication and witness determine task terminality; an open long-term obligation may be referenced and carried forward but cannot keep a completed task running.

nodes.label: Open Obligation Registry R1
nodes.description: Independent cross-task obligation authority for identity, status, owner plane, blocker, next eligible action, evidence and carry-forward lineage; obligation closure is not formal-task liveness.

nodes.label: Driver Console R1
nodes.description: Human-readable Driver Console projection that orders reconciliation, health, conflict, queue and resume obligations without becoming a second truth source.

nodes.label: Domain Pack Contract
nodes.description: Domain Pack manifest 与禁止权力升级的挂接契约。

nodes.label: Knowledge Domain Pack
nodes.description: 现有 Foundation、claims、Evidence、函数/非函数资产、Results 与知识体验的第一个 Domain Pack 引用面。

nodes.label: Research Pack / REOS LIGHT
nodes.description: REOS vNext LIGHT 作为有界 research pack 消费 Runtime，不定义 Runtime、权限或 Owner authority。

nodes.label: Writing Pack / 之元写作法
nodes.description: 之元写作法作为 L6 writing/publication pack，不进入 Generic Kernel 或提高 Runtime 权限。

nodes.label: Non-knowledge Runtime Pilot
nodes.description: 不依赖任何知识系统概念的确定性 manifest pilot，证明 Runtime 可在领域包之外闭环。

nodes.label: External Agent Federation R1
nodes.description: 点火 OS 与可替换外部执行器之间的统一协议、权限、验证、handoff、receipt 与记忆吸收边界；不复制任何供应商 runtime。

nodes.label: OpenClaw Adapter
nodes.description: OpenClaw 的 provider-neutral public CLI adapter；只暴露可观察 envelope、能力、健康和 pointer-only session，不把 Gateway、channel 或 daemon 带入点火。

nodes.label: Hermes Adapter
nodes.description: Hermes 的受限 text bridge adapter；仅允许声明的低风险读取 envelope，文本输出必须经过 typed parse、redaction 与独立验证。

nodes.label: Codex Adapter
nodes.description: Codex 的 JSONL public CLI adapter；默认 read-only、ephemeral、isolated config/rules、pointer-only thread，不保留 hidden reasoning 或危险 bypass。

nodes.label: Reference Executor
nodes.description: 现有本地 action plane 的冻结 Reference / Conformance / Fallback 角色；它验证协议，不向万能 Agent 壳、provider、daemon 或远端执行层扩张。

nodes.label: Future Executors
nodes.description: 未来执行器的声明式插槽；必须先满足统一 contract、最小权限、独立验证、可回执和隐私边界，不能以品牌或智能表现扩大协议。

nodes.label: Environment / Tools / Executors
nodes.description: Runtime 外部环境、工具能力与执行者接口；provider/model 只可进入 telemetry。

nodes.label: Executor Admission R1
nodes.description: Provider-neutral admission gate for installed agentic executors: public attestation, bounded interface, auth and billing policy, workspace/scratch isolation, structured result, capture, cleanup, validator and side-effect constraints are evaluated before live dispatch.

nodes.label: Live External Executor Bridge R1
nodes.description: OS-owned provider-neutral live dispatch bridge: capability leases, bounded process transport, strict executor receipts, timeout/cancel/reconciliation and independent validation; it owns no provider, channel, browser, remote Git, configuration or billing authority.

nodes.label: Live Observation / Reconciliation Plane R1
nodes.description: OS-owned bounded observation and reconciliation plane that separates probe, transport, live-process, durable-capture, structured-result, validation and unknown-effect states; reconciliation closure never infers success or no-effect.
